summary: Full backend + frontend validation of the new Trading Progress (Milestones) system on Trade Sentinel. Backend pytest suite (6/6 PASS) covers GET /api/progress correctness, achievements CRUD (create custom session_count NY AM, PUT update, DELETE), and PUT /api/progress/settings persistence. Frontend Playwright validated the full UI: login, /milestones page renders with data-testid='progress-page', 'Trading Progress' hero, 15 default achievements auto-seed, 'Unlocked' badge on unlocked cards, category filter (cat-Sessions -> 1 card), achievement-detail dialog, +Create builder saves a new card (16 total after create), Customize panel toggle-achievementsEnabled hides & re-shows the grid and persists via /api/progress/settings, del-ach-{id} removes the custom entry, and the real-time refetch after logging a new trade from the 'Add Trade' modal (subtitle 10 -> 11 trades, no manual reload). Regression: Dashboard Total Balance ($117,505 after new trade), equity-chart, and email/password login still work.

acceptance_test_results.GET /api/progress stats: PASS – total=10, winRate=70, netPL=4725; streaks / discipline factors / level / weekly / monthly / daily / goals(with completed) / achievements all present with per-item current/target/percent/unlocked. Auto-seeds 15 defaults on first call.
acceptance_test_results.POST /api/achievements (custom): PASS – session_count / NY AM / value=3 returns is_custom=true, appears in list and in /api/progress achievements array.
acceptance_test_results.PUT /api/progress/settings: PASS – {achievementsEnabled:false} persists; visible under prefs on next GET /api/progress.
acceptance_test_results.Frontend /milestones render: PASS – progress-page, hero 'Trading Progress' + 'Consistency compounds', 4 stat cards, Your Progress (Level/XP), Personal Records grid, Recent Performance (Today/Week/Month), Discipline Score with factor bars, Current Goals, 15 achievement cards, 6 'Unlocked' badges. Locked cards show progress bars with X/Y and %.
acceptance_test_results.Category filter: PASS – cat-Sessions narrows grid to 1 card (Morning Master).
acceptance_test_results.Achievement detail dialog: PASS – opens with data-testid='achievement-detail' on card click.
acceptance_test_results.Create achievement: PASS – +Create opens achievement-builder; ab-title/ab-target/ab-icon-Zap/ab-save creates a new card (16 total).
acceptance_test_results.Customize panel toggle: PASS – customize-panel opens; toggle-achievementsEnabled off hides the Achievements section (0 cards), toggling back on restores it (16 cards). Persistence via /api/progress/settings.
acceptance_test_results.Delete custom achievement: PASS – del-ach-{id} inside customize-panel removes the TEST_UI_ACH item.
acceptance_test_results.Real-time update after logging trade: PASS – opened 'Add Trade' modal from /milestones, filled Symbol=XAUUSD, Risk=100, Reward=300, saved; subtitle updated from '10 trades into your journey' to '11 trades' automatically (no page reload). Confirms data.trades change triggers /api/progress refetch.
acceptance_test_results.Regression: dashboard/equity/login: PASS – Total Balance shows $117,505.00, equity-chart visible, 11 TRADES LOGGED reflected, email/password login works, response key remains 'token'.

critical_code_review_comments: progress.py evaluate_achievement: win_rate branch overrides 'unlocked' outside the 'if rtype != win_rate' guard – double-check is fine, but consider unifying the guard to prevent future regression.
server.py _ensure_default_achievements uses per-user seeding on every /api/progress call – count check makes it idempotent but adds an extra count query per request; acceptable at current scale.
Milestones.jsx line 66: uses achievementsSummary counts always in subtitle even when achievementsEnabled=false; consider suppressing that count when the section is hidden for consistency.
AchievementBuilder ab-desc is not required or asserted server-side; consider trimming server-side too – currently trims client-side.

CustomizePanel Toggle uses local optimistic state but re-syncs from progress prop only on open; subsequent onChanged refresh does not update `local`. Not a blocker (values match), but if a save fails the UI won't visually revert.
test_credentials: admin@tradesentinel.com / Sentinel@2025 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Login response key is 'token'.
seed_data_creation: POST /api/trades/demo used (10 demo trades, $4,725 net P&L). One TEST_UI_ACH custom achievement created and then deleted through UI. One additional XAUUSD LONG trade (risk=100, reward=300) was logged via the frontend Add Trade modal to validate real-time refetch – it now persists in the user's trade log (total = 11).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Milestones/Progress system is fully working (backend + frontend + real-time refetch on data.trades change). Note: (1) the admin user now has 11 trades (one extra XAUUSD LONG from testing – harmless, or reseed via POST /api/trades/demo to reset the demo dataset); (2) run pytest with '-o addopts=\'\'' if xdist is enabled in pytest.ini; (3) frontend uses data-testids: progress-page, customize-btn, new-achievement-btn, cat-{Category}, achievement-{id}, achievement-detail, achievement-builder, ab-title/ab-desc/ab-target/ab-icon-{Name}/ab-save/ab-cancel, customize-panel, toggle-{achievements|streaks|xp|discipline|notifications}Enabled, edit-ach-{id}, del-ach-{id}, create-achievement-btn.
